Q1: How should the one-time "diagnosis + `ai:needs-human` + WARNING" for source PR #6535 be delivered?
Choices:
A) Build only the general intake behaviour. Every validated `autofix_failure` report whose reason is in `NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS` posts one idempotent diagnosis on its source PR, labels the PR `ai:needs-human`, sends a WARNING and logs `WORKFLOW_HEAL skip reason=non_retryable_<reason>`. PR #6535 is the acceptance example and is handled the next time a report for it reaches the intake. Nothing in this change targets #6535 directly. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Same as A. Also add a gated, idempotent backfill to an existing scheduled path, such as the poller tick or the intake. It handles PRs that already have a cap-tripped non-retryable marker on their current head but no diagnosis comment yet, so #6535 gets its diagnosis without a new failure. The backfill needs an entry in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` if it is single-use.
C) Same as A. The pipeline does nothing more for #6535; a human applies the label and resolves the hook conflict by hand.
